example.title: Santa Cruz Harbor west jetty (breakwater) and Walton Lighthouse
example.place: Santa Cruz, Santa Cruz County, CA

brief: The harbour's west jetty: a rubble-mound breakwater of big grey granite boulders capped with interlocking concrete dolosse, a flat walkable crest, ending at a small white lighthouse; fishermen on the rocks, a boat entering the channel. Three photos (the jetty seen from the harbour beach and the channel; the light itself is PEL-013). Older than 1970: the jetty (1964) predates 1970; the light on it is 2002. Piles carried 10 m or more below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).
